case_differences.question: Identify the type of expenses and their total value approved for 'October Meeting' event.
What is the amount of the funds that the Vice President received?
How many times was the budget in Advertisement for "Yearly Kickoff" meeting more than "October Meeting"?
Among all the closed events, which event has the highest spend-to-budget ratio?
Write the full names of students who received funds on the date of 9/9/2019 and include the amount received.

outcomes.sql:
SELECT budget.category AS type
FROM event
INNER JOIN budget ON event.event_id = budget.link_to_event
INNER JOIN expense ON budget.budget_id = expense.link_to_budget
WHERE event.event_name = 'October Meeting' AND expense.approved = 'Yes'
GROUP BY budget.category

SELECT e.expense_description, SUM(e.cost) AS total_value
FROM expense AS e
JOIN budget AS b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event AS ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE ev.event_name = 'October Meeting'
  AND e.approved = 'Yes'
GROUP BY e.expense_description

review.review_type: Evidence-based developer review; not independent blinded business labels; no official or contract score overrides.

observations.finding: Both arms changed approved = Yes to approved = true. Read-only database probe found true in31rows and NULL in1row; no Yes value. Outputs changed from empty to nonempty.
observations.remaining_issue: Forge groups by expense_description, Direct groups by budget.category, while Gold selects event.type and a single ungrouped total without an approved filter. Expense-type interpretation/reference conflict remains; do not silently relabel either new answer correct.

observations.finding: Forge changed date literal9/9/2019 to2019-09-09 and returned the same two people and amounts as Gold, with full names concatenated into one column. Direct kept9/9/2019 and returned no rows.
observations.remaining_issue: Forge remains a contract/official failure because two output columns differ from Gold three columns. Representation-equivalence check is diagnostic only, not a new score.

observations.finding: Treatment Forge put SQL-style aliases into scan=event e and join.table=budget b, then referenced e/b. Real compiler reproduces JOIN condition references undeclared tables: b,e. Control Forge and both Direct candidates pass.
observations.remaining_issue: A structured-representation failure observed in one generation pair; do not claim metadata deterministically causes it.

decision.reason: No official/contract gains; one Forge regression; combined token usage exceeds the predeclared1.20promotion ratio.
decision.next_target: Fix or prevent the observed Forge alias-representation failure before expanding evaluation; keep ambiguous output/reference cases distinct from confirmed wrong answers.
decision.generalization: No overall Luna accuracy claim from these five selected student_club cases.
